author: Unity
description:
This video takes you through the key features of Unity Studio, a new web-based, simplified creation tool within the Unity Industry ecosystem that empowers more team members to realize 3D ideas without complex software.

Unity Studio supports diverse industrial use cases such as:
 
Validate HMI prototypes for automotive or industrial dashboards. 
Create product configurators where sales and marketing teams can adjust colors and change components in real time for faster decisions. 
Demonstrate machine behavior step by step directly in the browser. 
Create training apps for operators. 

Unity Studio helps teams accelerate decisions, feedback, and production for real-time 3D applications. Anyone can build with Unity Studio. Start today at on.unity.com/unitystudio
title: Unity Studio: Introduction to the key features

author: Unity
description:
Unity Studio is a web-based, no-code editor designed for industries like manufacturing, automotive, healthcare, architecture, and more to build and share interactive 3D applications fast. Import CAD, BIM, or 3D data and bring ideas to life in minutes.

Learn more and sign up for our free 30-day Unity Studio trial: https://on.unity.com/unitystudio
